title: Coast Guard Rescues Two Teens Stranded on Aid to Navigation Platform
description:
The Coast Guard rescued two teenage boys Nov. 24, 2013 after the boy's 16-foot Jon boat became disabled and started taking on water in Currituck Sound, N.C., near aids to navigation marker 99.
A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew lowered a swimmer and hoisted the two boys into the helicopter.  U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Elizabeth City
